ns2:section.sectionText: Meeting schedule: In keeping with the principle of the topic of the class, LIS 590 UL will use both on and offline meetings, including extensive use of the GSLIS Moodle environment for posting materials and for discussion, required attendance and participation at lectures and events on campus, and face-to-face meetings of the class and/or subsets of the class at times agreed upon among participants. We will work with our and participantsø schedules to avoid conflicts with other classes and will establish a variety of face-to-face meeting times to complement other activities. While attendance will be required, face-to-face attendance will not be required for those with demonstrable conflicts. An orientation session will be established in the first week of class. Enrolled students will be contacted to determine the meeting time. See section description at http://lis.illinois.edu/oc/courses/catalog/catalog.html.
